stage_ledger.title: Read the Church
stage_ledger.question: How do I read the principal spaces of a Catholic church?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise principal architectural zones without treating architecture as proof of liturgical profile.

stage_ledger.title: Eucharistic Centre
stage_ledger.question: What are the principal sacred furnishings around the Eucharistic centre?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish altar, tabernacle, rail and other sanctuary furnishings.

stage_ledger.title: Word, Baptism & Confession
stage_ledger.question: How do I recognise the places associated with the Word, Baptism and Confession?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish pulpit, ambo, font, stoup and confessional.

stage_ledger.title: Behind the Liturgy
stage_ledger.question: What are the principal support spaces and furnishings behind the liturgy?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise sacristy, credence, sacrarium, architectural ciborium and retable.

stage_ledger.title: Devotion Around the Church
stage_ledger.question: How do devotional spaces differ from Eucharistic and liturgical spaces?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise Stations, images, votive areas and cemetery/churchyard spaces without confusing them with Eucharistic reservation.

stage_ledger.title: Why Churches Look Different
stage_ledger.question: Why do Catholic churches look different from one another?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand architectural and liturgical variation without inferring a rite from appearance.

stage_ledger.title: Read a Church Yourself
stage_ledger.question: Can I read an unfamiliar Catholic church accurately?
stage_ledger.objective: Apply the recognition distinctions from Course 1.

stage_ledger.title: Entering
stage_ledger.question: What should I notice when entering a church?

stage_ledger.title: Genuflect, Bow or Neither
stage_ledger.question: When should I genuflect, bow, or do neither?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish Eucharistic genuflection from bows and other forms of reverence.

stage_ledger.title: Stand, Sit, Kneel
stage_ledger.question: How do standing, sitting and kneeling work?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish current posture norms, 1962 ministerial rubrics, congregational custom and accessibility.

stage_ledger.title: Signs & Small Gestures
stage_ledger.question: How should I understand the smaller Catholic gestures used in worship?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise the Sign of the Cross, Gospel crosses, bows and related gestures without copying priestly rubrics automatically.

stage_ledger.title: Moving Around Church
stage_ledger.question: How should I move through a church or procession?
stage_ledger.objective: Apply reverence rules to movement without turning every furnishing into a cue.

stage_ledger.title: Silence & Conduct
stage_ledger.question: What does respectful conduct in church require?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish liturgical silence, pastoral etiquette and product privacy rules.

stage_ledger.title: Traditional & Local Customs
stage_ledger.question: How do universal discipline and local custom differ?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise 1962, current, devotional and local layers.

stage_ledger.title: Holy Communion in Catholic Life
stage_ledger.question: What does Holy Communion require from the communicant?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the practical consequences of intending to receive Holy Communion.

stage_ledger.title: Preparing for Communion
stage_ledger.question: How should I prepare for Holy Communion?
stage_ledger.objective: Identify objective preparation rules while avoiding app-based moral judgement.

stage_ledger.title: The Eucharistic Fast
stage_ledger.question: How long must I fast before Holy Communion?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish the 1962 Eucharistic fast from current discipline and the older midnight fast.

stage_ledger.title: Receiving Holy Communion
stage_ledger.question: How is Holy Communion received in the 1962 and current disciplines?
stage_ledger.objective: Follow reception discipline without mixing rites.

stage_ledger.title: When You Do Not Receive
stage_ledger.question: What should I understand when I do not receive Communion?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise that not receiving is distinct from not assisting at Mass and avoid judging others.

stage_ledger.title: Spiritual Communion
stage_ledger.question: What is spiritual Communion?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand spiritual Communion without confusing it with sacramental reception.

stage_ledger.title: Thanksgiving & Eucharistic Devotion
stage_ledger.question: How should Eucharistic life continue after Communion?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand thanksgiving, visits to the Blessed Sacrament and adoration without inventing obligations.

stage_ledger.title: Communion Outside Mass & Viaticum
stage_ledger.question: How do Communion outside Mass and Viaticum differ from ordinary Communion at Mass?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish legitimate Communion outside Mass and Viaticum.

stage_ledger.title: Why Confess
stage_ledger.question: Why does the Church ask Catholics to confess sins sacramentally?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the practical purpose and obligation of sacramental Confession.

stage_ledger.title: Examine Your Conscience
stage_ledger.question: How should I examine my conscience?
stage_ledger.objective: Examine conscience seriously without confusing a devotional aid with sacramental law.

stage_ledger.title: Contrition
stage_ledger.question: What is contrition and purpose of amendment?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish sacramental disposition from emotional intensity.

stage_ledger.title: How Confession Works
stage_ledger.question: What happens in sacramental Confession?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the practical flow without confusing preparation software with the Sacrament.

stage_ledger.title: Inside the Confessional
stage_ledger.question: How do confessional arrangements differ between 1962 and current discipline?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish sacramental essentials from confessional architecture.

stage_ledger.title: Your Penance
stage_ledger.question: What is the penance assigned in Confession?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish sacramental penance from optional devotional suggestions.

stage_ledger.title: After Confession
stage_ledger.question: What should I do after Confession?
stage_ledger.objective: Leave Confession with thanksgiving and avoid app-driven rechecking.

stage_ledger.title: Indulgences & Reparation
stage_ledger.question: What are indulgences and how do they differ from Confession or reparation?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish indulgence, penance, reparation and historical indulgence terminology.

stage_ledger.title: What Baptism Does
stage_ledger.question: What does Baptism do and why is it not repeated?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand Baptism's practical once-for-all character.

stage_ledger.title: Preparing an Infant
stage_ledger.question: How soon should an infant be baptised?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish the 1917/1962 and current formulations and know when Baptism is urgent.

stage_ledger.title: Godparents
stage_ledger.question: What is a godparent and who may serve?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish canonical sponsorship from honorary family custom.

stage_ledger.title: Signs of Baptism
stage_ledger.question: Which signs surround Baptism and which elements are essential?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish the essential sacramental action from surrounding liturgical signs.

stage_ledger.title: Emergency Baptism
stage_ledger.question: What is required for emergency Baptism?
stage_ledger.objective: Know the validity essentials and route immediately to the Emergency module when needed.

stage_ledger.title: Living Your Baptism
stage_ledger.question: How is Baptism lived after the ceremony?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand Baptism as continuing Christian identity rather than a one-day event.

stage_ledger.title: First Confession
stage_ledger.question: How should a child be prepared for first Confession?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand age-of-reason preparation without imposing adult-level complexity.

stage_ledger.title: First Communion
stage_ledger.question: How should a child be prepared for First Communion?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish essential sacramental preparation from surrounding customs.

stage_ledger.title: Discernment & Courtship
stage_ledger.question: How should courtship and marriage discernment be understood?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise courtship as free discernment rather than marriage itself or an app-predicted vocation.

stage_ledger.title: Engagement
stage_ledger.question: What is engagement and how did older sponsalia differ?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish engagement from marriage and the 1917 canonical sponsalia framework from current law.

stage_ledger.title: What Makes a Marriage?
stage_ledger.question: What actually makes a marriage?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the centrality of valid consent and distinguish it from rings, blessing or Mass.

stage_ledger.title: Preparing to Marry
stage_ledger.question: What preparation is required before marriage?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish current investigation from the traditional banns framework.

stage_ledger.title: Different Marriage Situations
stage_ledger.question: How do mixed marriage and disparity of cult differ?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish baptised non-Catholic and unbaptised situations in current and 1962 disciplines.

stage_ledger.title: The Wedding Liturgy
stage_ledger.question: How does the wedding liturgy relate to the marriage itself?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand consent, Nuptial Blessing and profile differences without duplicating a Mass manual.

stage_ledger.title: Living the Marriage
stage_ledger.question: How is Catholic marriage lived after the wedding?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand marriage as an ongoing vocation rather than a wedding-day event.

stage_ledger.title: When Marriage Is in Difficulty
stage_ledger.question: How should separation, divorce, nullity and convalidation be distinguished?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise distinct canonical and civil situations without turning the app into a tribunal.

stage_ledger.title: Serious Illness
stage_ledger.question: What should Catholics do when serious illness begins?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise when to call a priest and distinguish sacramental care from medical care.

stage_ledger.title: Anointing / Extreme Unction
stage_ledger.question: How do Extreme Unction and current Anointing of the Sick differ?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the same sacrament under materially different disciplinary criteria.

stage_ledger.title: Viaticum & Last Rites
stage_ledger.question: What are Viaticum and the traditional 'Last Rites'?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish Confession, Viaticum, Anointing and Apostolic Blessing.

stage_ledger.title: Accompanying Someone Dying
stage_ledger.question: How should someone accompany a dying Catholic?
stage_ledger.objective: Support the dying person with presence and prayer without confusing dying and death.

stage_ledger.title: When Death Occurs
stage_ledger.question: What changes when death has actually occurred?
stage_ledger.objective: Maintain a hard state boundary between dying and death-confirmed content.

stage_ledger.title: Wake & Funeral
stage_ledger.question: What are the wake and funeral for?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand Catholic funeral prayer without confusing current and 1962 rites or local wake customs.

stage_ledger.title: Traditional Requiem
stage_ledger.question: How do I recognise the traditional Requiem?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise principal features without duplicating the Requiem runtime.

stage_ledger.title: Burial, Cremation & Ashes
stage_ledger.question: How have Catholic burial and cremation disciplines changed?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish the 1962 prohibition, later change and current discipline on cremation and ashes.

stage_ledger.title: Continuing Prayer for the Dead
stage_ledger.question: How does Catholic prayer continue after a funeral?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand ongoing suffrage without turning traditional commemorations into a Purgatory timetable.

stage_ledger.title: What Is a Sacramental?
stage_ledger.question: What is a sacramental?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish sacramentals from sacraments and superstition.

stage_ledger.title: Holy Water, Candles & Blessed Branches
stage_ledger.question: How should holy water, candles and blessed branches be understood?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise common sacramentals and distinguish liturgical blessing from domestic custom.

stage_ledger.title: Rosaries, Crucifixes & Images
stage_ledger.question: How do rosaries, crucifixes and sacred images function in Catholic devotion?
stage_ledger.objective: Use devotional objects without confusing veneration, prayer and magic.

stage_ledger.title: Medals & Scapulars
stage_ledger.question: How should medals and scapulars be understood?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise approved devotional signs without treating promises as magic guarantees.

stage_ledger.title: Relics
stage_ledger.question: What are relics and how are they authenticated and classified?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish veneration, popular terminology and current administrative categories.

stage_ledger.title: Older & Unfamiliar Sacramentals
stage_ledger.question: How should older and unfamiliar sacramentals be understood?
stage_ledger.objective: Recover genuine historical sacramentals without treating age as proof of universal or current status.

stage_ledger.title: Caring for Sacred Objects
stage_ledger.question: How should sacred objects be cared for when they wear out or are damaged?
stage_ledger.objective: Apply reverence without inventing a universal disposal canon.

stage_ledger.title: Sacramental or Superstition?
stage_ledger.question: How can I tell Catholic sacramental use from superstition?
stage_ledger.objective: Apply the course's distinctions to devotional scenarios.

stage_ledger.title: The Catholic Day
stage_ledger.question: What can shape an ordinary Catholic day?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise a daily devotional rhythm without turning it into a legal timetable.

stage_ledger.title: The Catholic Week
stage_ledger.question: How does Catholic life shape the week?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish Sunday obligation, Friday penance and optional devotional associations.

stage_ledger.title: First Friday & First Saturday
stage_ledger.question: How do First Friday and First Saturday differ?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand both devotions without reducing them to streaks or automatic promises.

stage_ledger.title: Devotional Months
stage_ledger.question: Why are certain months associated with particular devotions?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand devotional months as overlays beneath the liturgical year.

stage_ledger.title: Ember Days
stage_ledger.question: What are Ember Days?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the four traditional Ember cycles, their penitential character and ordination association.

stage_ledger.title: Rogations & Processions
stage_ledger.question: What are Rogations and how do they differ from other processions?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand Rogation supplication and keep calendar dates separate from actual local procession events.

stage_ledger.title: Parish Rhythms
stage_ledger.question: What devotional rhythms can shape parish life beyond the universal calendar?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise missions, Forty Hours, retreats and local devotions without pretending they occur everywhere.

stage_ledger.title: Build a Catholic Rhythm
stage_ledger.question: How can I build a realistic Catholic rhythm?
stage_ledger.objective: Combine obligations and devotions without guilt-driven overload or gamification.

stage_ledger.title: Patron Saints
stage_ledger.question: What does it mean for a saint to be a patron?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand patronage as intercession and example without inferring formal patronage casually.

stage_ledger.title: Christian Names & Personal Patronage
stage_ledger.question: How do Christian names relate to personal patronage and name-day custom?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand name and patron relationships without automatic saint matching.

stage_ledger.title: Pilgrimage & Shrines
stage_ledger.question: What makes a journey a pilgrimage and a place a canonical shrine?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish pilgrimage, tourism, shrine status, local practices and indulgences.

stage_ledger.title: Bishop, Priest & Deacon
stage_ledger.question: What is the difference between bishop, priest and deacon?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise the three degrees of Holy Orders and distinguish them from titles or clothing.

stage_ledger.title: Religious Life
stage_ledger.question: How does religious life differ from Holy Orders?
stage_ledger.objective: Distinguish religious profession, priesthood, brothers, sisters and different community forms.

stage_ledger.title: Traditional Clerical Orders
stage_ledger.question: What were tonsure, minor orders and the subdiaconate?
stage_ledger.objective: Understand the traditional Latin clerical cursus without treating its stages as extra sacramental degrees.

stage_ledger.title: Vocations & Milestones
stage_ledger.question: How does vocation move through discernment and formation?
stage_ledger.objective: Recognise vocation milestones without treating formation as a prediction of the final state.

stage_ledger.title: Read the Wider Church
stage_ledger.question: How do I read the wider Catholic landscape accurately?
stage_ledger.objective: Keep sacramental degree, affiliation, community type, liturgical profile and canonical status separate.
